posts.title: Cisco Packet Tracer and networking fundamentals
posts.text: Completed Cisco Networking Academy’s Getting Started with Cisco Packet Tracer program. Practicing network topologies, data flow, and how devices communicate.

posts.title: AI Tools Workshop by be10x
posts.text: Workshop takeaways: clearer prompt engineering, practical AI workflows, and choosing the right tool for the task. Continuing to apply these ideas to projects and learning.

paragraphs: I’m a B.Tech student specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies – Technical Campus. Recent learning has focused on prompt engineering, practical AI workflows, and choosing the right tools for research, productivity, and technical tasks.

I’m also strengthening my networking fundamentals through Cisco Packet Tracer, practicing network topologies, data flow, and how devices communicate. I’m applying what I learn through hands-on projects as I explore AI and software development.
